plugins.name: tw-stock-etf-advisor
plugins.description: Taiwan AND US stock/ETF research, buy-sell decisions, holdings tracking, and Tokyo-Night K-line charting — two separate books (TWD/USD, no FX), two separate reports (0050 / 0052 common holdings + QQQ / S&P 500 pools, live-quote entry/exit plans, per-market trade ledgers, sell-signal review, market-aware candlestick charts with forward signals + post-mortem review panel, SQLite persistence with per-market trading calendars) — plus built-in trade discipline: thesis tracking with health scores, a mirror-test entry gate, move attribution, data-richness rating, and cross-source validation.
